factual_entities.name_en: Onion Agriculture & Traditional Karnataka Farming Tools
factual_entities.name_hi: प्याज की खेती और पारंपरिक कृषि उपकरण (कर्नाटक)
attributes: Onion Farming Sequence: Loosening soil with iron rod in July -> Sowing seeds -> Sprouting within 20 days -> Weeding (removing unwanted plants) -> Harvesting when leaves dry yellow (if delayed, onions rot in ground) -> Cutting dry leaves

Traditional Tools: 1. Khunti (खूंटी): Iron rod to loosen soil; 2. Kurige (कुरीगे): Wooden plough with funnel for sowing seeds; 3. Illige (इल्लीगे): Sharp curved cutter fixed on wooden stand to slice dried leaves from onions

visual_assets_and_diagram_cues: Diagram of Khunti (iron digging rod), Kurige (seed plough), Illige (curved cutter)
